# Smartlead

Smartlead is a sales engagement platform for managing cold email campaigns, leads, sending accounts, inbox activity, deliverability, prospecting, and sender provisioning.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/smartlead/.

## Actions

- **Create Draft Campaign**: Create a new campaign in DRAFTED status.
- **Create Smart Delivery Folder**: Create an organizational folder for Smart Delivery tests.
- **Delete Campaign**: Permanently delete a campaign and all associated sequences, mappings, and statistics.
- **Delete Smart Delivery Folder**: Delete an empty Smart Delivery folder.
- **Get Campaign** (read-only): Get configuration and performance summary for one Smartlead campaign by ID.
- **Get Campaigns** (read-only): Get configuration and performance summaries for 1-20 Smartlead campaigns.
- **Get Smart Delivery Test** (read-only): Get the documented configuration for one Smart Delivery spam test by ID.
- **Get Smart Prospect Usage** (read-only): Get Smart Prospect lead-search metrics, fetch counts, daily limits, and available credit balance.
- **List Campaigns** (read-only): List campaigns visible to the connected Smartlead account, optionally for one client.
- **List Email Accounts** (read-only): List connected sending accounts with health, warmup, usage, provider, and campaign filters.
- **List Inbox Replies** (read-only): List lead replies across campaigns from Master Inbox using bounded filters and one page at a time.
- **List Purchased Smart Senders Domains** (read-only): List domains already purchased through Smart Senders.
- **List Saved Smart Prospect Searches** (read-only): List saved Smart Prospect search definitions without executing them or consuming contact-search credits.
- **List Smart Delivery Folders** (read-only): List folders used to organize Smart Delivery tests.
- **List Smart Delivery Tests** (read-only): List Smart Delivery spam and inbox-placement tests.
- **List Smart Prospect Industries** (read-only): List and search Smart Prospect industry filter values without searching contacts or consuming contact-fetch credits.
- **List Smart Senders Vendors** (read-only): List Smart Senders marketplace vendors and current domain/mailbox pricing without placing an order.
- **Search Available Smart Senders Domains** (read-only): Check Smart Senders marketplace domain availability for a vendor.
- **Search Smart Prospect Contacts (Consumes Credits)**: Search one page of Smart Prospect contacts.
